title: Do You “Trust” This Visualization? An Inventory to Measure Trust in Visualizations
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and validating a psychometric inventory to measure human trust in data visualizations. While it discusses trust-related factors such as 'benevolence' and 'integrity' based on existing social science theories, these are treated as psychological dimensions of perceived trustworthiness rather than a benchmarking or evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
